blocks.text: Kamyab karobar chalane ke liye financial concepts (paise se juri bunyadi baatein) samajhna bohat zaroori hai. Chahe aap chhoti dukaan shuru kar rahe hon ya bari company chala rahe hon, paisa kaise kaam karta hai yeh jaan kar aap behtar faisle karenge aur karobar barhayenge. Is hisse mein hum Pakistan ki misalon se kuch basic (shuru ke zaroori) financial concepts dekhenge.

blocks.prompt: Karobar ke financial concepts entrepreneurs ki kis cheez mein madad karte hain (MCQ 8)?
blocks.explanation: (b) Resources (paisa, saaman aur waqt) sambhalna aur karobar barhane ka plan banana.

items: Financial concepts: revenue aur profit, expenses aur budget, investment aur savings, loan aur interest.
